name: Squee
description: The cabin boy of the Weatherlight.

description_citations.text: "Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth eyes Squee as bait to trap Avizoa.
timeline.quote: "Maybe we can trap them with bait," thought Tahngarth, eyeing Squee.

citation.text: Avizoa (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee whines about the goats that would fly.
timeline.quote: "But you *said* 'when goats fly!'" Squee whined.

citation.text: Phantom Wings (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee remembers Glok who loved storms.
timeline.quote: "Glok loved storms! He'd sit an' watch an' laugh through the whole thing. I miss him."

citation.text: Firestorm (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee realizes he is not the dumb one among the goblin grenadiers.
timeline.quote: For once, Squee realized, *he* wasn't the dumb one.

citation.text: Goblin Grenadiers (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee fears the forest is thinking about dinner too.
timeline.quote: Thinking of dinner made Squee realize that the forest was probably thinking the same thing.

citation.text: Call of the Wild (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee swaps a pebble for a warm ball and hides, murmuring Glok.
timeline.quote: Squee tucked the warm ball in his pocket and slipped a pebble in its place.

citation.text: Legerdemain (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee clutches his toy as horrors close in on Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Squee trembled and clutched his toy for comfort.

citation.text: Squee's Toy (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Orim writes that never has she seen so many made sick, and that they will never eat Squee's cooking again.
timeline.quote: We will *never* eat Squee's cooking again.

citation.text: Medicine Bag (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Skeletons board the ship in the Death Pits until Squee's Salvation Sphere repels them.
timeline.quote: which repelled the skeletons

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee recalls Glok loved bets and still owes him.
timeline.quote: Hey—he still owes me.

citation.text: Goblin Bookie (Unglued, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee misses Glok, who loved storms.
timeline.quote: I miss him.

citation.text: Firestorm (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee cheers 'Let's do it again!'
timeline.quote: Let's do it again!

citation.text: Time Warp (Starter 1999, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee watches his Kyren cousins fall with sympathy and relief.
timeline.quote: Squee watched his Kyren cousins fall with a mixture of sympathy and relief.

citation.text: Snuff Out (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee stumbles on the hidden hangar chasing a fly.
timeline.quote: Squee stumbled on the hidden hangar.

citation.text: Robber Fly (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth roars at Squee being called general.
timeline.quote: General *nuisance*, maybe.

citation.text: Squee, Goblin Nabob (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee comes to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren.
timeline.quote: the Dominarian goblin Squee would come to be regarded as a cultural hero of the Kyren

citation.text: "Goblin", section "Kyren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew escapes Mercadia City with the Cho-Arrim prisoners and learns of the myths of Ramos.
timeline.quote: Here, they learned of the myths of Ramos and why the Cho-Arrim had taken the Weatherlight to begin with

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A cateran enforcer submits to Squee, allowing the crew to escape.
timeline.quote: At the sight of Squee, the cateran enforcer stops and seeks pardon from the goblin.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee and Atalla drug the guards' wine to free the crew.
timeline.quote: The wine proves to be drugged, and Atalla secures the key to their shackles.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garbage falls on Xcric instead of the condemned Gerrard, Karn and Tahngarth.
timeline.quote: what they see is tons of filth fall right on top of Xcric!

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee discovers the secret underground hangar and stumbles into a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: he stumbles into a Phyrexian!

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight engine starts just as Volrath shoots at Squee.
timeline.quote: Just as Volrath shoots a crossbow bolt at Squee, the engine starts and the bolt just misses.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Volrath's control, Hanna, Karn and Squee are forced to repair the Weatherlight; the revolutionary forces attack.
timeline.quote: forced to repair the Weatherlight under the threat of Squee’s execution

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Rathi Overlay, Crovax oversees Phyrexian domination of Urborg, executes Tsabo Tavoc, and convinces Gerrard to submit to Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This convinced Gerrard to surrender himself to the Dark Lord.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Reign of Terror". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth mocks Squee about a giant's meal.
timeline.quote: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth.

citation.text: Lowland Giant (Beatdown Box Set, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Squee loses his appetite for bugs after meeting Phyrexian battleflies.
timeline.quote: After encountering them, Squee finally lost his appetite for bugs.

citation.text: Phyrexian Battleflies (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay jokes that Squee turned out a good shot.
timeline.quote: Who knew he'd be such a good shot?

citation.text: Zap (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai captures Gerrard and Squee and teleports them to the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: where he captured Gerrard (and, accidentally, Squee ) and teleported them into the Stronghold

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee overloads a Phyrexian healing device, killing Ertai in the explosion.
timeline.quote: killing Ertai in the explosion

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Squee are captured by Ertai, now a Phyrexian minion.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Squee were captured by a new minion of the Phyrexians: Ertai

citation.text: "Gerrard Capashen", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn gives up his pacifism, Gerrard breaks free, and with Karn grievously wounds Tavoc, who flees through the portal before Gerrard closes it.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Karn wound Tavoc grievously, and the Phyrexian only barely manages to flee through the portal before Gerrard closes it.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Stronghold Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Karn takes control of the Predator; Ertai steals Gerrard and Squee to Crovax, who sends Gerrard into Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: In a duel, Tahngarth killed Greven il-Vec and Karn took control of the Predator

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coalition storms the Stronghold as Gerrard kills Crovax and Squee kills Ertai.
timeline.quote: even as Gerrard killed Crovax and Squee killed Ertai

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Final stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year after the Invasion, Karn takes Orim back to Mercadia, and Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee receive a new vessel named Victory.
timeline.quote: which she named Victory

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai reveals himself and teleports Gerrard and Squee into the Stronghold, where Crovax kills Squee to prove Yawgmoth can bring back the dead.
timeline.quote: To prove it he kills Squee, who is then granted the ability to come back from the dead.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room where a crazed Crovax stands over Squee.
timeline.quote: with a crazed Crovax standing over the broken form of Squee

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard lands in the Stronghold throne room, reunites with Squee, and they defeat Phyrexian troops; Ertai summons Crovax back.
timeline.quote: Ertai realizes he can't defeat Gerrard and summons Crovax back to the Stronghold.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard kills Crovax, Squee fries Ertai, and the Dominarian forces escape on the Weatherlight as lava engulfs the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Gerrard kills Crovax with an axe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year later Freyalise erects a monument, and Karn, as an accumulation of the Legacy, takes Orim to Mercadia while Sisay, Squee and Tahngarth sail on the Victory.
timeline.quote: One year later, in a ceremony attended by survivors from all over the globe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee accidentally activates the Salvation Sphere, driving off Volrath's undead attackers in the Death Pits.
timeline.quote: the goblin cabin boy Squee accidentally activate the Salvation Sphere

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight is absorbed in the completed Legacy; Dominarians grant Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee a new ship, Victory.
timeline.quote: which Sisay named Victory

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Weatherlight's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker and Squee infiltrate Omek's fortress and kill the pretender Kedu; Omek abdicates.
timeline.quote: Together, they infiltrated Omek's fortress, killed the pretender to the throne, Kedu, and defeated Omek's soldiers.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Shiv, Vaash uses a curiosity to control Keltaz, who kills Benalish soldiers, and kills Squee and other goblins.
timeline.quote: causing Keltaz to kill several Benalish soldiers.

citation.text: "Vaash Vroga", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After a week without deaths, Squee learns from Bulp that goblin Rarp was crushed by a boulder.
timeline.quote: Like most goblins at any given moment, Rarp was standing in the wrong place at the wrong time and was crushed.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Rarp, still alive, leaks black oil from his eyes, revealing himself as a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
timeline.quote: Rarp's eyes shot open, and Squee's stomach dropped as a thick black oil began leaking from them.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee sends Bulp through a secret tunnel to warn a town that the Phyrexians are back and burns Rarp's body.
timeline.quote: "No, Bulp. You gotta tell them that the Phyrexians are back."

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee announces a celebration, planning to have the mana lamps turned off so torchlight will reveal gold-eyed sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: Squee hoped that a sudden influx of torchlight would allow him to see exactly how many gold-eyed sleeper agents he was dealing with.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Spurna reveals herself as a sleeper agent, impales Squee and throws him off the platform, killing him.
timeline.quote: Spurna's arm had twisted and reformed into a heated metallic spike.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee revives, sees the whole clan with gold-ringed eyes, and a rotting spell kills him again; the disguised Bulp is revealed to be Ertai.
timeline.quote: Ertai's spiked Phyrexian armor gleamed in the torchlight as the rot reached Squee's chest.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Ertai explains how Sheoldred found him and says he wants Squee to beg for death, and reveals he took the Salvation Sphere.
timeline.quote: "Or maybe, I came here to make an unkillable goblin beg for death.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Compleated goblins restrain Squee and sedate him on a table made of their fused bodies.
timeline.quote: One of the goblins had become a table, and Squee was shifted onto it.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee awakens compleated, Ertai plans to deliver him to New Phyrexia for study, and Squee shows his new weapons.
timeline.quote: "You won't be a king in New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee declares himself compleat; his arm blade severs the rope holding boulders, which crush him and set off a chain explosion of mana lamps that destroys the mountain.
timeline.quote: there was a smoldering crater of stone.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: In the afterlife, Salvation, taking Sisay's form, explains that it protected Squee's soul and offers him a choice of returning or passing on.
timeline.quote: Or you can walk through this threshold, and your soul will finally be returned to the aether.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee chooses to return to life for one more chance, and Bulp, back from his errand, finds his king alive.
timeline.quote: "I wanna go back, Sally, but I only want one more.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee and Bulp resolve to fight the Phyrexians together.
timeline.quote: "If Phyrexia's back, then it's up to smart goblins like us to kick their butts and settle the score."

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Squee orders his troops to attack the squishy parts.
timeline.quote: Squee's orders basically came down to "attack the squishy parts."

citation.text: Aggressive Sabotage (Dominaria United, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ertai compleats Aron Capashen and Squee's goblin clan.
timeline.quote: He compleated Aron Capashen and Squee's clan of goblins

citation.text: "Ertai", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee is disemboweled by a beautiful sliver.
timeline.quote: Squee had been disemboweled many times before, but never by something so stunningly beautiful.

citation.text: Gemhide Sliver (Commander Masters, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Bulp brings Squee news that Rarp was crushed under a boulder at the mountain home entrance.
timeline.quote: a fellow goblin, had been crushed under a boulder at the entrance to their mountain home

citation.text: "Bulp", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee and Bulp discover Rarp is alive and leaking black oil, a Phyrexian sleeper agent.
timeline.quote: indicating that he had been turned into a Phyrexian sleeper agent

citation.text: "Bulp", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee sends Bulp to warn the outside world; Bulp reaches a human town and reports the Phyrexian resurgence.
timeline.quote: Bulp boldly ventured forth to warn the nearby villages of this threat

citation.text: "Bulp", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The corrupted Ertai takes Bulp's form, then reveals himself to Squee, who believes Bulp dead.
timeline.quote: the corrupted Ertai had assumed Bulp's form briefly, before revealing his true self to Squee

citation.text: "Bulp", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An accidental explosion caused by Squee destroys the mountain and his Phyrexian kingdom; Bulp returns and is reunited with Squee.
timeline.quote: wiping out his entire Phyrexian kingdom in the process

citation.text: "Bulp", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A cateran enforcer almost wins the battle until it notices Squee.
timeline.quote: the battle was almost lost until the horror noticed that Squee was part of the crew

citation.text: "Cliffside Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The cateran submits to Squee and lets the crew escape into Mercadia City.
timeline.quote: the cateran allowed the crew to escape into Mercadia City

citation.text: "Cliffside Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Deniz killed several goblins who might have overheard the conspiracy, including Squee.
timeline.quote: Deniz killed several goblins who might have heard him discussing the conspiracy

citation.text: "Gavon Deniz", section "Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee led Darigaaz, Adeliz and the Traveler to reclaim the Mana Rig; the Traveler dispatched Deniz at the rig's helm.
timeline.quote: Squee led Darigaaz, Adeliz , and the Traveler in a campaign to reclaim the Mana Rig.

citation.text: "Gavon Deniz", section "Mana Rig". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of years later Squee finds a sleeper Phyrexian agent in his clan, and his ward Bulp is revealed as compleated Ertai, who seeks the Sphere and to compleat Squee.
timeline.quote: His ward, Bulp

citation.text: "Salvation", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai and the infiltrated goblins torment and partially compleat Squee.
timeline.quote: subjected him to relentless torment and transformation

citation.text: "Salvation", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee is crushed by boulders, causing an explosion that destroys the mountain and the Phyrexian agents.
timeline.quote: Squee was crushed by boulders, triggering an explosion that destroyed the mountain

citation.text: "Salvation", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee finds himself in an ethereal realm where the Sphere grants him one last life before returning him to the living.
timeline.quote: It granted Squee one last life to live before sending him back to the realm of the living.

citation.text: "Salvation", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aged ten, Squee saves Captain Sisay from his tribe, is exiled, and joins the Weatherlight crew as cabin boy.
timeline.quote: Squee saved Captain Sisay from his tribe and was exiled in response

citation.text: "Squee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath tortures Squee to force Hanna to fix the Weatherlight; allies intervene.
timeline.quote: Squee was tortured by Volrath to ensure compliance from Hanna

citation.text: "Squee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth grants Squee immortality so Ertai and Crovax can kill him repeatedly; Squee accidentally kills Ertai.
timeline.quote: granted immortality by Yawgmoth

citation.text: "Squee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee becomes king of a goblin clan by winning a trial by combat.
timeline.quote: Squee became the king of a goblin clan

citation.text: "Squee", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ertai captures and compleats Squee, but his body blows up the mountain and destroys the Phyrexian cell.
timeline.quote: Squee was captured by Ertai and fully Compleated

citation.text: "Squee", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee chooses to be revived once more, becoming a mortal goblin again.
timeline.quote: becoming a mortal goblin again

citation.text: "Squee", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Squee fights alongside Slimefoot in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Squee fought alongside Slimefoot in defense of Dominaria

citation.text: "Squee", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4205 AR Squee follows a bug into the hangar, finds the Weatherlight, and is knocked out by a Kyren.
timeline.quote: he was discovered by a Kyren , a Phyrexian dock worker, and knocked out

citation.text: "Subterranean Hangar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn rips off several of Tsabo's legs and Gerrard, helped by Squee, stabs her.
timeline.quote: Karn broke his oath of nonviolence and ripped several of the Phyrexian's legs off.

citation.text: "Tsabo Tavoc", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Ertai killed Squee repeatedly and returns to torment him.
relations.quote: Ertai had killed Squee repeatedly out of little more than spite and curiosity.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

relations.note: It chose Squee for its boon and protected his soul.
relations.quote: I'd chosen you as a worthy recipient of my boon.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

relations.note: Reveals herself as a sleeper agent and attacks Squee, stabbing him and throwing him from the platform.
relations.quote: sending him plummeting to the mountain's stone floor.

citation.text: "Death and Salvation" by Dan Sheehan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Aug 2022.

relations.note: Submitted to the goblin's will, thinking him a Kyren.
relations.quote: Quickly submitting to the goblin 's will

citation.text: "Cliffside Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Squee did not stay dead for long.
relations.quote: including Squee , who didn't stay dead for long

citation.text: "Gavon Deniz", section "Dragons". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Came to torment and compleat him
relations.quote: who had come to torment Squee and recover the Salvation Sphere

citation.text: "Salvation", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Squee", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: He especially detested the goblin Squee

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
